# why: a three-feature one-pager — no accounts, no money, one flow.

# Rosewood Dog Walking — map summary (plain language)

What your site will have, and how each thing behaves:

1. **Homepage / services** — visitors land from Google or a card you hand out; they see your three walk
   options with prices; every section links onward. Nothing here dead-ends.
2. **Booking form** — the visitor picks a service, leaves a phone number, sends. They always get a
   confirmation screen, and if the send fails they see what happened and a retry.
3. **FAQ** — answers about areas, hours and payment; every answer links back to the booking form.

Where people come in: Google search, the card's QR link, a friend's text.
Where they can leave: any page (normal), or mid-form — the form keeps what they typed
when they come back.

Open questions (need a real answer):
- Exact service radius — default while open: "within 20 minutes of the shop".
